scope: Reuse of existing transfer/restart source readiness audit, bound to frozen274 actual inputs/build. No new CFD/test job. NOT actual transfer, continued-adapted-CFD or disk-restart proof.

required_runtime_evidence.native: Every rank strict q/J/geometry/edge/requested-height acceptance and actual event-specific outputs.
required_runtime_evidence.mass_solve: Parse EACH field/time-level true residual from conservative-P1 table,not the configured CG tolerance;finite and<=1e-10. ConservativeKernels.cpp:454-457 enforces true CV-mass residual;CDistributedProjection.cpp:1434-1448 checks all fields.
required_runtime_evidence.target_integral_and_admissibility: Distributed CConservativeTransfer.cpp:997-1038 and serial:1275-1302 enforce all transferred states admissible and scaled TARGET-integral defect<=1e-12 BEFORE array publication. Confirm actual path completed in the event. Report numerical target defects only if actually exposed;old/new domain integral changes and post-CFD integrals are not that measurement.
required_runtime_evidence.continued_cfd: Actual adapted Cycle1/2 solves and event-specific history;independently verify saved matching-grid coordinates,finite conserved fields,positive density/internal energy.
required_runtime_evidence.disk_restart: After owned workflow is terminal,pin/copy actual accepted mesh+.native_ref+matching restart into a NEW isolated directory. Use explicit final checkpoint basename,SOLUTION_FILENAME distinct from RESTART_FILENAME,ADAP_LOOP=NO,RESTART_SOL=YES,READ_BINARY_RESTART=YES. Run actual same-binary/runtime CFD continuation;validate disk input/output identity and admissible continued state. No original-grid substitute.

known_limits: run_m6.py workflow_accepted only checks ordered stage markers,finite old/new domain integral changes,mesh outputs and following history;not sufficient alone for strict transfer or isolated restart acceptance.
PrintSummary reports true mass residuals but not numerical final target-integral defects;successful hard-gate execution must be distinguished from observed numerical values.
Steady isolated restart does not fix resumed adaptation-loop cycle numbering/input-overwrite or rejected-event consumption.
